items.summary: MONAI's TensorRT export/compile path (monai/networks/trt_compiler.py, convert_to_trt/trt_compile in monai/networks/utils.py) is NVIDIA-only and inert on ROCm (tests skip). A ROCm equivalent would be a new MIGraphX/torch_migraphx backend that neither upstream nor AMD-Ecosystem/MONAI amd-develop has. Planner recommends defer; Jeff rules defer vs now before MONAI is marked planned.
